messages.subject: irace 4.3 release
messages.body_plain:
Dear irace users,

irace version 4.3 is available for download. This is a minor bugfix release that fixes the bugs listed below.

New features and improvements
Updated MATLAB examples and instructions in the User Guide.
Fixes

Add extra whitespace before the first and after the last boxplots in plotAblation() <https://mlopez-ibanez.github.io/irace/reference/plotAblation.html> so that boxes will not overlap with plot margins.

Fix bug in readConfigurationsFile() <https://mlopez-ibanez.github.io/irace/reference/readConfigurationsFile.html> when a fixed parameter that is both conditional and disabled does not appear in the input file.

Fix #87 <https://github.com/MLopez-Ibanez/irace/issues/87>: Using a dependent parameter may produce an error when sampling a different parameter.
Best wishes,

Manuel.
